column3: Are you really that happy about it?
This is my first time here after all... Kirino and Saori haven't been here before, right?
That's true. However, is it really something to be proud of?
Hmm. But, that... how should I put it...
It's like our relationship has become better, I guess?
A kid's fallacious reasoning... I just didn't have an opportunity, that's all. Don't delude yourself into thinking it's only you that I'll invite over.
My house isn't that big, but please enter.
...W-What's with that face brimming with anticipation?
I don't look like that. I'm just nervous.
There's nothing to be nervous about. After all, nobody's home.
Thank goodness I've prepared some countermeasures...
